provenance.source: Byte-exact private archive inputs previously provided by owner; processed locally, not fetched from HF in this run
provenance.runtime: Python/sklearn 1.8.0, no GPU or model generation

method.historical_message_inclusion: Non-System user/assistant content, original stripped string length >= 12
method.comparison: Cosine similarity, each R50 field against each of 669 R45 messages, max per field
method.warning: Thresholds are exploratory triage heuristics, NOT statistical independence evidence

excluded_scope: Hidden character pseudonyms, translated/romanized aliases or coincidental identical names
Paraphrased or semantically equivalent events without n-gram overlap
Full private cross-world narrative and all historical versions
privacy: No raw text, prompt case IDs, character names, narrative excerpts, source UUIDs, case-level scores or answer keys emitted
